The sibling recovery sidecar outputs/retest/phase2a/image-only/run_3/detections_image-only_run03.tiles.json records {"total_tiles": 340, "completed": [... 340 ids, including K-35-052-4_32635_x0_y0.png ...], "failed": [], "patched": ["K-35-052-4_32635_x0_y0.png"]}, and the run GeoJSON contains detections for that tile. | Checked for ALL 126 rows this turn, not just the exemplar: every one has execution_stats.items_failed == 0, items_processed == tiles.json total_tiles == len(tiles.json completed), tiles.json failed == [], and every meta failed_items id present in BOTH the tiles.json patched list and its completed list. 349 tiles patched in total across the 126 passes. | The recovery mechanism is scripts/lib_batch_api.py:2283-2292 (--patch-tiles): "completed_set.update(all_recovered); tiles_data[\"completed\"] = sorted(completed_set); tiles_data[\"failed\"] = sorted(pending); tiles_data[\"patched\"] = sorted(all_recovered)". | The stale-list semantics are documented in the code that was written to absorb them, scripts/lib_llm_metadata.py:1149-1153: "Defensive cleanup: any failed_items entry whose item_id appears in the combined completed_items list is stale (the item was actually processed successfully in either the original or recovery pass). This protects against historical drift where failed_items was not refreshed after a successful retry" — and in the project post-mortem, docs/notes/reflections/abductive-reasoning.md:4592: "`execution_stats.failed_items[]` is an **append-only historical log**, not a current-failure signal. defence_search: Searched for a defence of the derived "partial": protocol-errata.md (no erratum mentions --patch-tiles, failed_items or the patch/recovery accounting — a genuine documentation gap), decisions-log.md and execution-checklist.md (silent), the study YAMLs, the .tiles.json sidecars, and the working notes. NEAREST MISS: docs/notes/working-notes.md:13810 asserts the OPPOSITE reading for the GS-v2 verifier metas — "`items_processed: 0` and `items_failed: 0` are broken accounting fields; the `failed_items[]` array is the authoritative count (correctly 18 unrecovered)" — i.e. there is a real, attested class of metas where failed_items IS the truth and the counters lie, which is exactly what the re-derivation script assumed here. Also considered and rejected: that items_failed==0 is itself the double-logging bug of docs/notes/reflections/session-reflection.md:6667 (log_success called before parse, so a tile lands in both lists) — that bug would leave the id in completed_items, whereas here the id is absent from completed_items and present in tiles.json patched, which is the recovery signature, not the double-log signature.

NEAREST MISS: configuration.full_config_snapshot.temperature is ALSO 0.0 in both metas, and its _config_notes even say "0.0 based on Phase 3d: T=0.5 and T=1.0 did not improve over T=0.0 baseline" — a reader taking the snapshot at face value would wrongly conclude the pilot ran at 0.0.
